svg.title: Workshop availability: add status words at the point of use
svg.desc: Only three local status labels become visible. Existing colored dots, legend, dates, times, capacities, fonts, geometry and photograph remain fixed. Open, Waitlist and Full name the status without hue matching. Fictional example. Generated photographs reused unchanged; typography composed separately.
svg.text: BEFORE · Dots require matching a color key
AFTER · Each session names its status
